title: One Piece, Vol. 1: Romance Dawn
description: Monkey D. Luffy sets out to become King of the Pirates with his straw hat and rubber powers obtained from eating the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit, recruiting the fierce swordsman Roronoa Zoro.

title: One Piece, Vol. 2: Buggy the Clown
description: Luffy and Zoro face off against Buggy the Clown and his pirate crew in Orange Town, crossing paths with the cunning cat burglar and navigator Nami.

title: Naruto, Vol. 1: Uzumaki Naruto
description: Orphaned prankster Naruto Uzumaki dreams of becoming the greatest Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, carrying the sealed Nine-Tailed Fox spirit inside him.

title: Dragon Ball, Vol. 1: The Monkey King
description: Young Son Goku, a monkey-tailed martial artist living alone in Mount Paozu, meets the teen genius Bulma and embarks on a legendary quest to find the seven wish-granting Dragon Balls.

title: Attack on Titan, Vol. 1
description: Humanity shelters behind colossal walls to survive man-eating Titans. When a Colossal Titan breaches the outer barrier, young Eren Yeager vows to exterminate every Titan.

title: Death Note, Vol. 1: Boredom
description: High school prodigy Light Yagami discovers a supernatural notebook dropped by Shinigami Ryuk that can kill anyone whose name is written in it, drawing the attention of master detective L.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, Vol. 1: Cruelty
description: In Taisho-era Japan, kindhearted Tanjiro Kamado finds his family slaughtered by demons and his sister Nezuko turned into one, setting out on a path to become a Demon Slayer.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 1: Ryomen Sukuna
description: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed talisman finger belonging to the King of Curses Ryomen Sukuna to save his classmates, enrolling in Tokyo Jujutsu High under Satoru Gojo.

title: Chainsaw Man, Vol. 1: Dog & Chainsaw
description: Impoverished youth Denji works off his deceased father's debt by hunting devils with Pochita, the Chainsaw Devil. After a betrayal, Pochita merges with Denji's heart, resurrecting him as Chainsaw Man.

title: Spy x Family, Vol. 1
description: Master spy Twilight creates a cover family for Operation Strix, unknowingly adopting Anya, a telepathic orphan girl, and marrying Yor, a lethal assassin code-named Thorn Princess.

title: Tokyo Ghoul, Vol. 1
description: College student Ken Kaneki barely survives a deadly date with a ghoul who attacks him, waking from surgery to find he has been transformed into a half-ghoul who craves human flesh.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist, Vol. 1
description: Brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric attempt forbidden human alchemy to resurrect their mother, losing limbs and body, leading them on a quest for the Philosopher's Stone.

title: Berserk, Vol. 1
description: The Black Swordsman Guts roams a grim medieval world wielding a massive Dragonslayer sword, pursued by demons bearing the Brand of Sacrifice.

title: Sakamoto Days, Vol. 1: The Legendary Hitman
description: Taro Sakamoto was an unrivaled hitman feared across the underworld. Falling in love, he retired, got married, had a daughter, opened a convenience store, and put on weight—until past enemies track him down.

title: Bleach, Vol. 1: The Strawberry and the Soul Reapers
description: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki can see ghosts. When his family is attacked by a monstrous Hollow, Soul Reaper Rukia Kuchiki transfers her powers to Ichigo, making him a Substitute Soul Reaper.

title: My Hero Academia, Vol. 1: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
description: In a world where 80 percent of humans possess superpowers known as Quirks, powerless Izuku Midoriya catches the eye of legendary hero All Might, inheriting the ultimate One For All ability.

title: Hunter x Hunter, Vol. 1: The Day of Departure
description: Twelve-year-old Gon Freecss embarks on a perilous journey to take the grueling Hunter Examination and find his legendary father Ging, befriending Killua, Kurapika, and Leorio.

title: Vinland Saga, Book 1
description: Raised by the Viking mercenary band who murdered his father, young Thorfinn grows into a terrifying warrior obsessed with dueling commander Askeladd to avenge his family honor.

title: Haikyu!!, Vol. 1: Hinata and Kageyama
description: Despite his short stature, Shoyo Hinata is determined to fly on the volleyball court like his idol 'The Little Giant', unexpectedly teaming up with genius setter Tobio Kageyama at Karasuno High.

title: Solo Leveling, Vol. 1 (Comic)
description: Sung Jinwoo is known as the 'Weakest Hunter of All Mankind'. Trapped in a terrifying double dungeon, he survives and awakens a mystical Quest system allowing him alone to level up endlessly.

title: Dandadan, Vol. 1
description: Momo Ayase believes in ghosts but not aliens; Ken 'Okarun' Takakura believes in aliens but not ghosts. Testing their beliefs in haunted spots, both discover occult spirits and extraterrestrials are terrifyingly real.

title: Blue Lock, Vol. 1
description: After Japan's disaster at the 2018 World Cup, eccentric coach Jinpachi Ego gathers 300 elite high school strikers into the high-tech prison facility 'Blue Lock' to forge the world's most egotistical forward.

title: Kaiju No. 8, Vol. 1
description: Kafka Hibino cleans up monster corpses after Defense Force battles, having abandoned his childhood dream. When a parasitic kaiju forces its way into his mouth, Kafka gains monster strength while retaining human consciousness.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 1--Phantom Blood, Vol. 1
description: In Victorian England, noble Jonathan Joestar encounters his ambitious adopted brother Dio Brando. When Dio dons an ancient Stone Mask transforming into a vampire, Jonathan masters the Ripple martial art.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, Vol. 1
description: Elven mage Frieren and her heroic party defeat the Demon King in a ten-year quest. Decades later, her mortal comrades pass away from old age, prompting Frieren to embark on a tender journey to understand humanity.

title: Oshi no Ko, Vol. 1
description: Country doctor Gorou Amemiya is a devoted fan of 16-year-old idol sensation Ai Hoshino. When Ai arrives at his hospital pregnant with twins, a fateful murder reincarnates Gorou as Ai's newborn son Aquamarine.
